title.en: renegade craft fair at hangar 30 opens at eleven.
title.de: renegade craft fair in hangar 30 öffnet um elf.
title.tr: hangar 30'da renegade craft fair saat on birde açılıyor.

line.en: makers and handmade goods under one roof at magnuson park; weekend hours are 11 to 5, so the morning is easy.
line.de: handgemachte waren unter einem dach im magnuson park; wochenendöffnung von 11 bis 17 uhr, gut für den vormittag.
line.tr: magnuson park'ta tek çatı altında el yapımı ürünler; hafta sonu 11 ile 17 arası açık, sabah için uygun.

sparks.why: Renegade Craft Fair at Hangar 30, Magnuson Park, 20-22 Nov 2026 per TheCraftMap and Planomato (weekend hours 11am-5pm).
